items.summary: Recommend containment-only execution. Authorize no new discretionary spend, monetization expansion, production work, requeues, or forecasts. AI spend was $963.569 across 5,390 calls from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-26; infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, and other operating costs are not reported. Revenue evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. Site-attributed commission is $0 because the commission is in an aggregate provider row that cannot be assigned without inventing attribution. Contribution margin and ROI are not calculable because the period-aligned cost ledger and attributable revenue are incomplete. Cost-to-learn is not calculable because experiment-level cost and incremental attributable outcomes are absent. Budget exposure is unbounded because monthly spend, fixed costs, marketing budget, revenue floor, and attribution materiality limits are blank. Minimum measurement: a period-aligned site/fleet cost ledger covering AI, infrastructure, domains, labor, marketing, and other direct costs; site/content-level revenue attribution; experiment-level cost and incremental outcomes; and owner-approved budget limits with actual-versus-budget reporting. Continue only existing source-dated measurement, reconciliation, failure repair-or-close review, and bounded evidence work. Do not treat impressions, clicks, sessions, conversions, AI calls, SEO scores, or technical scores as financial returns.

Reject unsupported revenue, margin, ROI, causal-lift, cost-to-learn, and forecast claims. The available one-day revenue window and partial aggregate attribution do not support site economics or forward projections. Preserve the $4.92 aggregate commission as unassigned and the $0 site-attributed commission as the only supported site-level revenue figure. No new finance proposal or discretionary spend is justified this cycle.
